notes: This Valentine's Day themed board focuses on affection and social-emotional vocabulary central to the book. 'Love' and 'heart' are core concepts throughout. 'Baby' refers to Baby Llama, the main character. The book celebrates expressions of love to family and friends, so social words like hug, kiss, friend, and family are prioritised. Llama Llama is a highly distinctive named character — generic Boardmaker llama images will not match the beloved series illustration style.
